GXAPIConfig.description: Select a local profile or configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

GXAgnesImage.description: Generate an image through Agnes with up to four reference images.

GXAgnesText.description: Generate text through Agnes, optionally using a system prompt and an image.

GXAgnesVideo.description: Generate video from text, an image, or keyframes through Agnes.

GXComfyPilotConnection.description: Provide a service address to ComfyPilot and Agnes nodes.

GXComfyPilotText.description: Generate text using a provider and model from the ComfyPilot service.

GXGenerationConfig.description: Connect an API config and select the generation settings for its protocol.

settings_api_seed_mode.name: Send model seed
settings_api_seed_mode.tooltip: Send the execution seed only when supported by the OpenAI-compatible service.

GXHighPassSharpening.description: Sharpen edges using a high-pass filter with adjustable blending.

GXLLMChatCompletions.description: Send text, skills, and media using a connected GX Generation Config.

execution_seed.name: Execution seed
execution_seed.tooltip: Increment to rerun or keep the seed fixed to reuse cached results. The seed is sent to the model only when enabled in the request config.

GXOutpaintingSize.description: Calculate padding on each side from the target size and offsets.

GXSaveImagePlus.description: Save images with date folders, two levels of subfolders, and PNG metadata.

GXSaveImagesByName.description: Save an image batch using one filename per image. Files are saved under the ComfyUI output directory.

filenames.name: Filenames
filenames.tooltip: Enter one filename per image, or connect a list from a loop. Use names without directory separators. Existing files receive a numeric suffix.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Images to save in the same order as the filename list.

output_dir.name: Output directory
output_dir.tooltip: Choose a folder under ComfyUI output. A relative path is resolved from output.

GXSavePathAppend.description: Append an optional date, subfolders, and a filename prefix to a base path.

GXSavePathCombiner.description: Build a save path from optional date and folder segments.

GXSaveVideo.description: Save a video with the selected container, codec, and quality.

GXSharedLoadAudio.description: Load a downloaded audio result from shared compute.

GXSharedLoadImage.description: Load a downloaded image result and its mask from shared compute.

GXSharedLoadVideo.description: Load a downloaded video result from shared compute.

GXShowTextAndUnescapeUnicode.description: Decode Unicode escapes and show the resulting text on the node.

GXSkillCatalog.description: List the names and descriptions of local skills. Refreshes when the directory changes.

GXSkillConfig.description: Choose skills in the order they should be applied.

skill_folder.name: Skill directory
skill_folder.tooltip: Leave empty to use .comfypilot/agents/skills, or enter a local directory.

skills.name: Selected skills
skills.tooltip: One skill per line, followed by optional resource paths separated with vertical bars. Use GX Skill Catalog to list available names.

GXVideoReverse.description: Reverse the order of a frame batch and report its duration at the selected frame rate.

GX_TopazFrameInterpolation.display_name: GX Topaz Video AI Frame Interpolation
GX_TopazFrameInterpolation.description: Interpolate video to a target frame rate or create slow motion. Image dimensions stay the same. Supports Topaz Video AI 6.2.1. Configure the Topaz FFmpeg path under Settings > GXNodes > Topaz Video AI.

fi_fps.name: Output frame rate
fi_fps.tooltip: Target output frame rate, such as 30 or 60 fps. 0 leaves the frame-rate option unset. Frame interpolation alone keeps the original image size.

fi_model.name: Interpolation model
fi_model.tooltip: Choose Chronos Fast for speed, Chronos for quality, or Apollo for non-linear motion. Model availability depends on the installed Topaz Video AI version.

fi_rdt.name: Duplicate frame sensitivity
fi_rdt.tooltip: Controls duplicate-frame detection. Higher values treat more similar frames as duplicates. Start with the default and increase gradually.

fi_slowmo.name: Slow motion
fi_slowmo.tooltip: 1 keeps the original speed. Larger values create slow motion, such as 2 for half speed. Audio is copied at its original speed.

frames.name: images
frames.tooltip: Video frames as an IMAGE batch. Connect the images output of your video loader.

0.name: images
0.tooltip: Processed video frames. The default decode limit is the first 512 frames.

1.name: video path
1.tooltip: Absolute path to the complete processed video file on this ComfyUI host.

GX_TopazEnhancement.description: Enhance video with Rhea or Proteus and set the output size. Supports Topaz Video AI 6.2.1. Configure the Topaz FFmpeg path under Settings > GXNodes > Topaz Video AI.

frames.name: images
frames.tooltip: Video frames as an IMAGE batch. Connect the images output of your video loader.

up_blend.name: Blend
up_blend.tooltip: Mixes original source detail back into the enhanced result. 0 uses the enhanced result; 1 mixes in the most original detail. Available with Proteus.

up_blur.name: Deblur
up_blur.tooltip: Adjusts deblurring strength. Higher values may sharpen soft detail but can also introduce artifacts.

up_compression.name: Revert compression
up_compression.tooltip: Reduces compression artifacts such as blocks and ringing. Increase gradually for low-bitrate footage.

up_details.name: Recover detail
up_details.tooltip: Adjusts recovery of fine texture. Increase gradually; excessive values may introduce artificial detail.

up_halo.name: Dehalo
up_halo.tooltip: Reduces bright or dark halos around edges. Excessive correction can soften edges.

up_height.name: Output height
up_height.tooltip: Output height in pixels when Scale is 0. Use an even number. 1280 x 720 to 2560 x 1440 doubles both dimensions.

up_model.name: Enhancement model
up_model.tooltip: Rhea provides general enhancement and upscaling. Proteus provides adjustable restoration controls. Available controls depend on the model.

up_noise.name: Reduce noise
up_noise.tooltip: Reduces existing image noise. Higher values can remove more noise and fine texture. This is separate from Add Noise.

up_preblur.name: Preblur
up_preblur.tooltip: Adjusts pre-processing blur. Increase gradually to soften noise or artifacts before enhancement; too much can remove detail.

up_scale.name: Scale
up_scale.tooltip: 0 uses Output width and Output height. A positive value requests a model scale factor. Support depends on the selected model.

up_width.name: Output width
up_width.tooltip: Output width in pixels when Scale is 0. Use an even number. Set width and height in the source aspect ratio to avoid stretching.

up_add_noise.name: Add Noise
up_add_noise.tooltip: Adds a small amount of noise to reduce an overly smooth appearance. 0 disables it. Uses the Topaz Video AI Add Noise slider scale, from 0 to 10.

up_model_up_blend.name: Blend
up_model_up_blend.tooltip: Mixes original source detail back into the enhanced result. 0 uses the enhanced result; 1 mixes in the most original detail. Available with Proteus.

0.name: images
0.tooltip: Processed video frames. The default decode limit is the first 512 frames.

1.name: video path
1.tooltip: Absolute path to the complete processed video file on this ComfyUI host.
